runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification; touching timestamps is not verification. Existing records keep their own verifiedAt unless their public detail was actually reopened or otherwise reconfirmed.
runSummary.note: Fresh 11.9.2026 18:18 sweep actually searched 11 source families: Profesia, direct-company careers, LinkedIn Jobs public index, Worki, Brigada.sk, Kariera/Zoznam, Pretlak/StartupJobs/WordPress Jobs, Upwork, Reddit/WordPress communities and public Facebook indexing. No new promotion-grade unique hit cleared location, language, skill and trust gates. Kariera surfaced same-day Bratislava technical inventory including Slovak Telekom fixed-network work at 1770 EUR and Metrohm IT Support at 1800 EUR, but Telekom requires at least electrical qualification §21 and Metrohm remains burdened by B1/B2 English plus degree/practice requirements. LinkedIn surfaced Nexcess Technical Support Engineer in Bratislava/remote-from-Bratislava at 1300-2000 EUR, but Linux-terminal/network knowledge is mandatory, and Sharp Brains L1 desktop support is onsite B2B with incomplete pay/language evidence. The CLOSER web-admin listing remains a stale-index trap: current result pages surface it, while the canonical government record ended 31.8.2026. Upwork produced Worldwide WordPress/VA candidates, but closest results were low-budget, expert/development-heavy, strong-English/phone-heavy or geographically restricted. Facebook public indexing produced 0 concrete verifiable hiring posts.

developmentBacklogAdded.title: Cross-source expiry conflict detector
developmentBacklogAdded.reason: When a current result page republishes or refreshes an older vacancy but an authoritative canonical source has an explicit closing date in the past, automatically flag a source-date conflict and block promotion until the canonical status is reconciled. This prevents false freshness such as CLOSER web admin appearing current on Kariera while the government record ended 31.8.2026.

developmentBacklogAdded.title: Mandatory qualification gate extractor
developmentBacklogAdded.reason: Extract legally or professionally mandatory certificates such as §21/§22, tachograph card, VZV licence or vendor certification before detailed scoring. Treat mandatory certificates as explicit knockout evidence rather than merely lowering fit, saving review time on otherwise attractive technical roles like Telekom fixed-network service.
